item.title: From Onboarding to Production: How I Built Dynamic Vendor Switching at Wise
item.description: 🚀 When I joined Wise, I tackled a significant problem: creating a system for automatic vendor switching during payment failures. 🔍 The solution involves understanding existing systems, choosing the right signals, and validating decisions in shadow mode. This ensures reliable and efficient handling of customer payments without manual intervention. 📊 We track vendor status and conversion rates to make informed switching decisions. item.title: Observability At Scale — Every Byte Counts
item.description: 💡 Discover how Wise achieved a 40% reduction in monthly observability costs through five strategic changes! The team focused on enhancing efficiency across their platform, which serves millions globally. Key improvements included optimizing log compression, upgrading metrics collectors, and streamlining query processes. These adjustments not only cut costs but also ensured reliable service delivery for customers. #Efficiency #Observability #Wise #CostReduction #TechInnovation
